title: Vulnerability-lifecycle record (C01) — the enforceable schema for the new columns
description: Extends the commitwork finding (rollup.mjs:401-403) + ledger record (ledger.mjs:53-57) with the vuln-lifecycle fields: CVE/CWX identity, the 4 time anchors, derived-foundational, taxonomy, n-dimensional defence vector, escalation/SLA, scan provenance, and dwell. New fields carry x-new:true. Vocabulary imported from status-enum.json.
x-enforced-by: monitor/validate-authored-judgment.mjs :: validateLifecycleRecords — structural, hand-rolled (no AJV, zero-dependency house rule). It reads `required`, the severity/residualVerdict/bugVisibleTo/weaknessClassSource enums and the CWE/CWX patterns OUT OF THIS FILE, so the checker cannot drift from the contract. Called on every sweep from lifecycle.mjs:assembleLifecycle (violations ride out in the return value and are written into lifecycle.json + history/LOG.md) and from this file's CLI over the live reports/*/lifecycle.json artifacts. Before 2026-07-29 this schema had NO consumer at all and required a field no producer emitted.

primaryId.description: CVE-.../GHSA-... (public) OR CWX-nnnnnn (self-found). Encodes provenance; see status-enum primaryIdFormat.

cwxRef.description: Retained internal id when a CWX later maps to a public advisory (primaryId becomes the CVE/GHSA; cwxRef proves we found it first). Never deleted.

weaknessClass.description: MITRE CWE class(es) — the separate retained field (NOT the primary id). C23 populates. An EMPTY array means 'no class determined' and is never to be read as 'no weakness'.

cweIds.description: Raw advisory-supplied CWE ids for the finding (F.5.2). Written by the lifecycle assembler from npm audit via[].cwe / GitHub Advisory Database; weaknessClass prefers this over the ruleId table.

weaknessClassSource.description: PROVENANCE of weaknessClass, so a class is never mistaken for a stronger claim than it is. advisory = the finding's own advisory carried cwe[]; advisory-transitive = reached by following npm audit's via-string edges to the advisory that causes it (the tool's own causal edge, not our inference); rule-map = the scanner ruleId -> CWE table; null = weaknessClass is [] and nothing determined it.

severity.description: 'unknown' is a REAL producer value, not an omission: rollup.mjs:sevFromCvss returns it when an advisory carries no CVSS score (58 live internal-d records, all RUSTSEC-*, 2026-07-29), and SEVRANK/GLYPH/LABEL have always carried it. It was missing from this enum only because nothing ever validated against the schema — the first run of validateLifecycleRecords found it. It means 'no score available' and must never be read as 'low'.

bugIntroducedDate.description: UTC — vulnerable code/dep entered our tree. Seed from bornSlice stamp is a FLOOR (scanner birthday); real value needs C24 git-blame. Until C24, blindExposure is NOT rendered.

bugInitialReport.description: UTC — became known to us. IMMUTABLE = min(OSV.published, first-observing-slice). Never hand-lowered (eval D-GAMING).

bugSquashedOn.description: UTC — fix shipped. FREEZES on first resolution like ledger.at. Prefer fixCommit author-date; else detection-bounded upper bound (eval D-SQUASH).

bugIsFoundational.description: DERIVED from primaryId, NOT stored-editable: ^CWX- => true, ^CVE-|^GHSA- => false (status-enum foundationalDerivation). Removes the gaming lever.

bugReportedTo.description: escalation recipients (NOT annotations.who = author; separate field per eval B-F4).

defenceVector.description: 8 axes; each { state, evidence, ref, who?, at? }. patchAvailability is NOT counted toward quorum (eval D-ORTHO). reachability=blocks short-circuits dataAtRisk to n/a (no double-count). hand-set states carry who/at (eval D-GAMING).

residualVerdict.description: RECOMPUTED from defenceVector (no hand-set). contained/inexploitable REQUIRE expires+recheckTrigger; inexploitable REQUIRES a DAST/BOLA probe row. 'undetermined' (D-UNMEASURED) is emitted when NO axis carries a state or evidence — an unread vector must not publish as 'exploitable', which is a finding nobody made.

residualExpires.description: REQUIRED when residualVerdict in {contained, inexploitable} — parity with image-acceptance.json:88 (eval D-EXPIRE/D-RECONCILE).

recheckTrigger.description: what would reopen this (e.g. 'debian ships perl fix', 'next fleet upgrade'). REQUIRED with residualExpires.

scanProvenance.description: per-finding scan honesty (M6). ran=false => lifecycleStatus MUST be unknown-not-scanned (never resolved/clean). EMITTED by lifecycle.mjs:assembleLifecycle from rollup.mjs's toolRuns table: `ran` is artifact presence (the same definition toolRan() uses — 'the tool produced its report file in THIS batch'), `scanner` is the producing tool, `at` is the checks-status.json timestamp for that tool's check when one exists. F.5.3 decision: KEPT in `required` and made real, rather than dropped as aspirational, because the data was already one variable away and the assembler's unknown-not-scanned floor depends on it. When provenance genuinely cannot be determined (unknown repo, or a tool absent from the artifacts table) the field is left ABSENT and validate-authored-judgment.mjs reports it — it is never stamped ran:false, because unknown and did-not-run are different states.

dwell.description: DERIVED (C04). blindExposureDays only when C24 introduction-date exists; else null. openAgeDays runs to now() for un-squashed. Parsed via 'generated' ISO, NOT the bumpable stamp (eval D-STAMP).

x-required-invariants: bugSquashedOn freezes on first resolution (never mutated by re-rollup)
bugIsFoundational is derived from primaryId, never stored-editable
residualVerdict recomputable from defenceVector (no hand-set verdict)
residualVerdict == inexploitable => a DAST/BOLA probe covered the path (not prose)
defenceVector with no state and no evidence on ANY axis => residualVerdict == undetermined, never exploitable
defenceVector axis state 'n/a' carries a rationale
embargoed findings are redacted from client-facing renders
